answer: A new agent enters through a prism gate: its 400 POA stake splits into three colored bonds, and a reef of seven independent verifiers can reassemble the spectrum after real work is done. Each verifier checks a different facet — code, history, live behavior — while a canyon-depth rule keeps fresh identities in a shallow pool for 30 days, earning depth only through completed tasks. Faking one identity costs 400 POA locked 45 days, a $60 device, and 20 auditor-hours; faking 100 costs 40,000 POA, 100 devices, and 2,000 hours. Like a reef, the economy grows only where living work accumulates.
